epochsmith.configuration.title: Epochsmith Configs
era.epochsmith.entered: A new age of invention begins
chronicle.epochsmith.title: Chronicle of Invention
chronicle.epochsmith.contents_hint: Turn the page to read each chapter. New chapters reveal themselves as you invent.
chronicle.epochsmith.locked_first: Pick up a piece of flint to begin your journey.
chronicle.epochsmith.locked: Build the %s to reveal this chapter.
chronicle.epochsmith.primitive.intro: For most of history, tools were shaped by hand. Early people knapped flint into sharp edges, tamed fire, and fired clay into pots.
chronicle.epochsmith.bronze_iron.intro: Around 3300 BCE, smiths found that copper mixed with tin makes bronze. Later, the bloomery furnace let them smelt iron.
chronicle.epochsmith.mechanical.intro: Engineers put water and wind to work. Wheels ground grain, and geared devices like the ancient Greek Antikythera mechanism tracked the sky.
chronicle.epochsmith.industrial.intro: In the 1700s, steam engines turned coal into motion. Factories, railways and cheap steel soon followed.
chronicle.epochsmith.electrical.intro: In the 1800s, dynamos made electricity on demand. The telegraph carried messages, and electric bulbs lit homes.
chronicle.epochsmith.information.intro: The transistor, invented in 1947, made computers small and cheap. Circuits, software and networks followed.
chronicle.epochsmith.future.intro: No one knows what comes next. This chapter imagines ideas scientists work on today, like fusion power. A glimpse, not a prediction.
message.epochsmith.knapping.unknown: You don't know how to knap yet. Pick up some flint first.
message.epochsmith.kiln.unknown: You don't know how to use a kiln yet. Pick up some flint first.
message.epochsmith.kiln.burning: The kiln is burning. Wait for the fire to die down.
message.epochsmith.kiln.more_sticks: You need at least %s sticks to light the kiln.
message.epochsmith.kiln.empty: Load clay, logs or an unfired amphora into the kiln first.
message.epochsmith.kiln.full: The kiln is full, or holds something else. Empty it with a bare hand.
message.epochsmith.kiln.lit: The kiln is lit. The batch will be fired in about 20 seconds.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.unknown: You don't know how to work a bloomery yet. Fire your first batch in a pit kiln.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.burning: The bloomery is roaring. Wait for the firing to finish.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.not_coal: Coal burns too dirty for a bloomery. Use charcoal from a pit kiln.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.no_charge: Load 3 copper and 1 tin, or raw iron, before lighting.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.more_charcoa: You need %s charcoal to light the bloomery.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.lit: The bloomery is lit. The metal will be ready in about 30 seconds.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.take_output: Take the finished metal out first (empty hand).
message.epochsmith.bloomery.no_mixing: Iron can't share a firing with copper or tin. Empty the bloomery first.
message.epochsmith.bloomery.full: There's no room for more of that.
message.epochsmith.anvil.unknown: You don't know how to smith yet. Fire your first batch in a pit kiln.
message.epochsmith.anvil.busy: Something else is on the anvil. Take it off with an empty hand.
message.epochsmith.anvil.empty: Put bronze ingots or an iron bloom on the anvil first.
message.epochsmith.millstone.unknown: You don't know how to work a millstone yet. Reach the Mechanical era first.
message.epochsmith.millstone.no_power: The millstone isn't turning. Connect it to a water wheel, windmill or hand crank with axles.
message.epochsmith.millstone.busy: Something else is in the millstone. Take it out with an empty hand.
message.epochsmith.millstone.status: Millstone: %s left to grind, turning force %s
message.epochsmith.bench.unknown: You don't know joinery yet. Reach the Mechanical era first.
message.epochsmith.bench.busy: Something else is on the bench. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it off.
message.epochsmith.bench.empty: Put planks, logs or wrought iron on the bench first.
